rules.rawText:
Backyard Breaks x ClipHouse 
Account Creation Guide

How to set up Backyard Breaks clip pages before posting.

Start Here
If you already have a Backyard Breaks clip/highlight account, use that account first. Do not create a new account unless you need one.
 1. Account Requirement
• Use a dedicated Backyard Breaks clip page. Do not post campaign submissions from your personal account.
• The account should look like a clean Backyard Breaks highlights/fan page, not a random repost account.
• If your existing Backyard Breaks account has posting history and looks clean, use it.
• New accounts should be set up fully before the first post: handle, profile photo, bio, and link.
2. Username / Naming Conventions
Naming Goal
The name should clearly tell viewers this page is for Backyard Breaks clips, pulls, highlights, or moments.
 

Preferred Format
 Examples
 backyardbreaks_[word]
 backyardbreaks_pulls / backyardbreaks_moments / backyardbreaks_hits
 backyardbreaks[modifier]
 backyardbreaksclips / backyardbreakshighlights / backyardbreaksreels
 bbreaks_[word]
 bbreaks_pulls / bbreaks_hits / bbreaks_moments
 backyard_[word]
 backyard_pulls / backyard_hits / backyard_moments
 Do Not Use
• Personal names as the main handle.
• Random meme handles with no Backyard Breaks connection.
• Handles that make the page look like a different card brand.
• Handles using another agency, unrelated business, or unrelated creator name.
3. Profile Picture
• Use a logo provided in the folder below.
• Do not use a personal photo, a custom image, another brand logo, or an unrelated sports card image.
Profile Picture Options —> Backyard Break Profile Pictures
4. Bio Requirements
Bio Goal
The bio should make the account feel official/credible enough to drive people to the live stream, while keeping the CTA simple.
 

Bio Option
 Copy/Paste

5. Link in Bio
• The link in bio must always point to the Backyard Breaks live stream or approved Backyard Breaks destination.
• This is the most important conversion element on the profile. Every viewer who clicks is a potential buyer in a break.
• Do not link to your personal page, another creator, another store, a linktree you control, or an unrelated site.
• If you are unsure which link to use, ask your campaign manager before posting.
6. US Targeting Rules
• This campaign is built for US awareness and US stream traffic.
• Set account language, captions, hashtags, posting times, and references for a US audience.
• Post during US-friendly windows when possible: afternoon/evening Eastern Time usually gives the content a better chance to reach active buyers.
• Use US sports context when relevant: NBA, NFL, MLB, WNBA, college hoops, and major American player names.
• Do not write captions as if the audience already knows the hobby. Explain the value with price and rarity.
7. Platform Setup Checklist
• TikTok account created or existing Backyard Breaks account selected.
• Instagram account created or existing Backyard Breaks account selected.
• YouTube Shorts account/channel created or existing Backyard Breaks account selected.
• Handle references Backyard Breaks, pulls, clips, highlights, moments, or breaks.
• Profile picture is the official Backyard Breaks logo.
• Bio uses an approved format.
• Link in bio points to the approved live stream destination.
• Account is ready before clips are submitted to Whop.
8. First Post Rule
Do This Before Posting
Make the account look complete first. Empty profile + first post + no bio link looks low-quality and can hurt trust. Set up the account, then post your strongest value-led clip first.
 

CONFIDENTIAL - INTERNAL USE ONLY | ClipHouse | We Distribute. You Grow.
